Same intra-General Fund departmental transfer (pp17-18): detail out 32,500 + 7,500 + 7,500 (General departments) + 7,500 (Street) + 85,755 (Grants) + 99,000 (Infrastructure Improvement) = 239,755 vs statement 214,755 (p7); the statement's General column nets the 25,000 Fire department transfer in against Administrative's transfer out.
